integrity: Exact tensor-projector proof and positive polynomial certificates; standalone Python standard-library exact-rational verifier supplied. Bounded primary-literature comparisons, with residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: For finite, unweighted Cartesian products of complete graphs and the exact two-stage fourth-order Gauss--Legendre end-step rational map only. Positivity of internal stages, floating-point computations, arbitrary networks and alternative methods is not asserted. Negative witnesses may require graph-dependent large timesteps; independent validation is not claimed.
title: Sharp all-step Gauss positivity on Cartesian products of complete graphs
